full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance-inspired oil portrait shows a bearded man in richly patterned dark clothing seated against a deep olive-brown background. He occupies nearly the whole left and center of the frame, turning his head to the right while his body angles slightly toward the viewer. A soft dark cap with a feather or gathered decoration sits over thick brown hair. Warm light catches his high forehead, nose, cheek, and full beard, leaving the far side of the face in gentle shadow. His gaze is directed toward something beyond the right edge, giving the pose a composed, attentive quality. At his neck, a pale ruffled shirt rises beneath an ornate vest and heavily worked outer garment. Gold embroidery, dark red fabric, braided trim, and puffed sleeves form dense textures across the shoulders and chest. One forearm extends toward the left edge and rests low in the frame, while the other hand holds a small cup near the lower center. A worn metal plate or pale folded fabric catches a brighter highlight on the right sleeve. The background remains dark and uncluttered, with subtle brown-green variations that separate the silhouette without revealing a specific room. Warm directional light enters from the upper left, drawing fine highlights across the jewelry-like trim and broad satin folds while deeper creases turn nearly black. Brushwork is smoothest on the face and more varied on patterned cloth, allowing material richness to support rather than overwhelm the expression. The overall composition is dignified and close, balancing a calm sideward gaze with layered gold, cream, burgundy, and deep brown surfaces.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形文艺复兴气息的油画肖像描绘一位蓄胡男子，穿着纹样丰富的深色衣服，坐在深橄榄棕背景前。他占据画面左侧和中央的大部分，头转向右方，身体略朝观者。一顶柔软深色帽戴在浓密棕发上，帽上有羽饰或聚拢的装饰。暖光照到高前额、鼻子、脸颊和浓密胡须，面部远侧保留柔影。他望向右画框之外，使姿态显得端庄而专注。颈部浅色褶领从华丽马甲和精工外衣下伸起。金色刺绣、深红布料、编绳饰边和蓬松袖子在肩胸上构成密集纹理。一侧前臂向左边缘伸出，置于画面较低处，另一只手在下方中央附近握着一只小杯。右袖上的旧金属片或浅色折布承接较亮高光。背景深暗而简净，细微棕绿变化把剪影分开，却不揭示具体房间。暖色定向光从左上进入，在珠宝般的饰边和宽阔缎面褶皱上描出细亮线，更深折缝则转为近黑。面部笔触最平滑，纹样布料上变化更多，让材料的丰盛支持而不压过神情。整体构图端庄而亲近，以平静的侧向目光平衡层叠的金、奶油、酒红与深棕色表面。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting uses warm, controlled illumination to model rounded forms against a dark brown-green ground. Cream highlights and muted gold thread through broad burgundy and umber masses, giving the dense palette a clear hierarchy. Central smooth areas transition into intricate woven, ruffled, and metallic textures, with fine edges reserved for selected embellishments. Shadows deepen in folds and at the margins, while directional light keeps the focal surfaces luminous. The close, balanced framing allows material richness and restrained expression to coexist. The overall effect is stately, tactile, and quietly opulent.
style_prompt_zh: 这类油画用温暖而受控的照明，在深棕绿色底上塑造圆润形体。奶油色高光与低调金色穿过大片酒红和赭褐色块，使浓密配色有清楚层次。中央的平滑区域过渡到精细编织、褶皱和金属肌理，锐利边缘只留给选定装饰。阴影在折缝与边缘加深，定向光让焦点表面发亮。亲近而平衡的取景使材料丰盛与克制神情共存。整体效果庄重、可触且安静华贵。
theme_en: A bearded man in ornate dark garments holding a small cup
theme_zh: 一位蓄胡男子身穿华丽深色衣饰、手握小杯
name: Renaissance
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
